text: My office has received reports of speeding and dangerous driving on Soho Street and Phoebe Street in the Grande Neighbourhood. This area is near an elementary school, a daycare, and contains bicycle lanes and heavy pedestrian traffic. After receiving the reports of speeding and dangerous driving, I received a petition for the installation of speed humps from local residents. I am requesting that this council waive the petition and polling requirements, and authorize the installation of traffic calming measures.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the petition and polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming on Phoebe Street, between Beverley Street and Huron Street. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install two speed humps on Phoebe Street, between Beverley Street and Huron Street, generally as shown on attached Drawing No. 421G-3557, dated October 2019, to the letter (December 2, 2019) from Councillor Joe Cressy. 3. Waived the petition and polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming on Soho Street, between Queen Street West and Phoebe Street. 4.
